title: Stability: the signals that predict a collapse
design_ref: Stability: the signals that predict a collapse
purpose: Run the RL recipe with a learning rate 25 times higher, as a one-key ablation. The health monitor, a separate Deployment reading the tracking store, must raise trend alerts, and they must come no later than the reward collapse. The healthy run must raise none of them.

checks.description: the monitor raised at least one trend alert on the high-learning-rate run
checks.because: Rules compare the latest three steps with the run's first three: entropy, gradient norm, response length, importance ratios, KL.

checks.description: the first trend alert came no later than the reward collapse (or there was no reward collapse within the run)
checks.because: Entropy and the gradient norm move as soon as updates are too large; reward is a lagging signal.

checks.description: the monitor also flagged the slower failure
checks.because: The same rules, on a run that degrades over tens of steps instead of four.

checks.description: the healthy run raised no alert
checks.because: Its learning rate keeps every signal within the rules' bounds.

notes: At learning rate 1e-5 the first trend alert came at step 15 and the reward collapse rule fired at step 16.
